nameRules.display: Exactly 'Penny Royal': two words, capital P and R

palette.accentPolicy: flat marks are pure black/white; violet is a restrained accent in detailed artwork and page accents only; text is silver/white on dark or obsidian on light

typography.wordmark: DejaVu Sans ExtraLight, outlined to native SVG paths (no consumer font dependency)
typography.companion: headings: clean readable sans-serif with restrained tracking; body: normal readable weights per host-site typography
typography.license: Bitstream Vera / DejaVu public-domain notice, see FONT-LICENSE.txt

emblem.geometry: eight fill-only measured polygons; do not alter
emblem.clearSpace: 15% of emblem width on all sides

assets.logos/emblem-white.svg: monochrome white standalone emblem for dark backgrounds
assets.logos/logo-stacked-light.svg: stacked lockup, pure black, light backgrounds
assets.logos/logo-stacked-dark.svg: stacked lockup, pure white, dark backgrounds
assets.logos/logo-horizontal-light.svg: horizontal lockup, pure black, light backgrounds
assets.logos/logo-horizontal-dark.svg: horizontal lockup, pure white, dark backgrounds
assets.reference/approved-concept.png: approved original concept image, 1536x1024 RGB; all emblem geometry derives from it
assets.artwork/penny-royal-crystal.png: text-free crystal hero artwork, 1672x941 RGB wide near-16:9, artwork on right with dark left space for page headings
square crystal cutout, 1254x1254 RGBA with genuine alpha
assets.artwork/PROMPTS.md: source prompts for the supplied artwork

origin: Name inspired by Penny Royal, the AI in Neal Asher's Polity universe: https://www.nealasher.co.uk/penny-royal-iii-started/
